'''Library-temples''' were structures used by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the millennium before the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. Library-temples were places used by sorcerers of pure Sith-blood for meditation, and for places to record the findings and results from their experiments and experiences.<ref name="A Tale from the Dark Side">{{WEGCite|story=A Tale from the Dark Side|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref>
